summary: Completed i18n localization testing for HomeMe compound management app after JSON file split. Homepage and Login page language switching works correctly for all 3 languages (EN/AR/FR). Dashboard and sidebar translations work. Found several missing/incorrect translations in specific components.

ui_bugs.issue: Remember me checkbox shows Arabic text 'تذكرني' in English mode. Key 'remember_me' is nested under 'enterprise' object but Login.js uses t('remember_me') at root level
Shows raw translation keys 'no_requests' and 'no_requests_description' instead of translated text - keys missing from translation files

issues: Table header shows Arabic 'إجمالي الوحدات' instead of 'Total Units' in English mode
Stats card shows Arabic 'إجمالي الوحدات' instead of English - the en.json has Arabic value for 'total_units' key
Table header shows Arabic 'تغيير الدور' instead of English
ROLE column shows Arabic 'ما له التطبيق' instead of English
Multiple Arabic texts visible in English mode: 'ما لي الرصيد', 'الميزانية العمومية', 'المقارنة الشهرية', 'سداد الوحدات', 'المصروفات حسب التصنيف', 'ملخص الالتزامات', 'المتبقي', 'تصدير Excel'

action_items: Fix Login.js: Change t('remember_me', 'تذكرني') to t('enterprise.remember_me') OR add 'remember_me' key at root level in all locale files
Add missing translation keys to en.json/ar.json/fr.json: 'no_requests', 'no_requests_description'
Fix en.json: Change 'total_units': 'إجمالي الوحدات' to 'total_units': 'Total Units'
Review and fix Financial Management component translations - multiple hardcoded Arabic strings
Review and fix User Management component translations - table headers showing Arabic
critical_code_review_comments: i18n JSON file split from monolith to 3 files (en.json, ar.json, fr.json) completed successfully - files load correctly
Some translation keys are nested under objects (e.g., 'enterprise.remember_me') but components use flat keys
en.json has Arabic text for 'total_units' key - copy/paste error from ar.json
MaintenanceSystem.js missing translation keys: no_requests, no_requests_description
Financial Management and User Management components have hardcoded Arabic strings not wrapped in t() function
